RANK: CURVQUOTA-SWAP-SID | position=2 | reason=Acts at all three levels with per-item successor mass times per-edge standardised curvature plus exact 2-swap quotas, the strongest genuine per-item behaviour-by-geometry coupling that cannot move usage counts (E11 0.0907); but its own risk concedes the bias (0.1-0.4 vs distance spread ~1) may not move items, eta_2=-0.24 leaves the level-2 bottleneck (E6 depth-2 survival 0.829) inert, m_l is undefined, and its curved commitment plus tangent-space EMA reopens the round-1 codebook risk.
RANK: QUOTAPERM-HYP | position=3 | reason=Safest of the five: conserving the whole triple bag (247/7414/20223, 0.177 collision) makes collapse algebraically impossible and it re-pairs items to triples at all levels with a scale-free rank fusion; but an ordinal rank-sum over a 32-candidate set with an undefined B_i can easily be a near-no-op, it never touches Stage 2 so the E8 first-level ceiling (K=256 0.0822 vs 0.0907 baseline) stays binding, and no measured arm supports a post-hoc permutation.
RANK: EQVOTE-HYP-RQ | position=4 | reason=Clean bounded additive vote with a derived lambda and quota-exact transpositions, but the measured sign gate (delta_3=+0.399 only) confines it to level 3, leaving the level-1 lever that produced the largest measured gain (l1_br 0.04671 -> l1_br_euclid 0.06207) untouched; it is the closest analogue of tangent_successor_residual, which measured exactly the 0.05500 baseline, and its risk 4 concedes the Poincare kernel may be Euclidean-equivalent.
RANK: geopull-exactquota | position=5 | reason=Most aggressive per-item geodesic construction, but its deferred-acceptance solve never states the code-side preferences and lambda_l is undefined, so the minimal-specification clause fails; the 0.05 flip trigger with a 30-refresh cap freezes an early-epoch assignment for most of the 3000 epochs, it concedes stable-not-optimal matching can degrade reconstruction, and it is the same successor-geodesic family the evidence measured at 0.05500/0.05463.
